body:
Add the user `.cps` folder resolver, atomic post file storage, folder scan, and a read-only preview service in `crates/app`.

## Scope

1. Add a user post store in `crates/app` mirroring `crates/app/src/machine/store.rs`. Resolve `CAMCRAFT_POSTS`, or `<platform data dir>/camcraft/posts` (`%APPDATA%\camcraft\posts`, `~/Library/Application Support/camcraft/posts`, `$XDG_DATA_HOME/camcraft/posts`, or `~/.local/share/camcraft/posts`).
2. Write `.cps` files atomically (temp file beside target, then rename). Validate plain filenames and reject path separators or traversal. Never write into `assets/posts/`.
3. Allow saving work-in-progress `.cps` drafts even when the script has compile errors, and report compile status back to the caller. Keep `SelectPost::validate` (`crates/app/src/commands/post.rs`) and `posting::post_setup` refusing broken scripts before assignment or NC file output.
4. Scan `<user_posts>/*.cps` cleanly to list user scripts alongside `posting::BUILTINS`.
5. Add a read-only preview entry point (`preview_post`) that runs `crates/post` with `RuntimeLimits`, machine JSON, sample stream, and optional `postOptions`. Return G-code text, counted `warnings`, `swallowed` count, and structured 1-based errors (`line`, `column`, `message`). Never write NC files on disk during preview.

## Rules

- Keep file size under 400 lines per module (`AGENTS.md`).
- Preview never bypasses `posting::post_setup` for machine output.

## Done means

- Tests verify `user_dir_for` across Windows, macOS, and Linux plus `CAMCRAFT_POSTS`.
- Tests verify atomic saves and plain-filename rejection on path traversal inputs.
- Tests verify `preview_post` returns G-code, counted warnings, and 1-based error locations without creating any `.nc` file.
- Tests verify that `SelectPost` and `SetSetupPost` load saved valid user `.cps` files and refuse broken ones.

Part of #2050
